name: WhatsApp Account-custom_company
label: Company
description: Scope this WhatsApp account to a specific company. Leave blank for a shared/global account.

name: WhatsApp Notification-custom_company
label: Company
description: Only fire this notification for documents belonging to this company. Leave blank to fire for all companies.

name: WhatsApp Templates-custom_session_strategy
label: OpenWA Session Strategy
description: How OpenWA picks the sending session for this template: the account's default session, or a random connected session (spreads volume across the account's sessions). Only applies when the account routes via OpenWA.

name: Bulk WhatsApp Message-custom_openwa_section
label: OpenWA Routing
description: Only applies when the selected WhatsApp Account sends over the OpenWA gateway.

name: Bulk WhatsApp Message-custom_routing_mode
label: Routing Mode
description: How this campaign picks a sending session. Account-level keeps every message on one number. Message-level spreads them across the sessions below. Hybrid stays on the default session until it runs out of send rate or daily cap, then spills to another. Leave blank to use the account's own setting.

name: Bulk WhatsApp Message-custom_openwa_sessions
label: Sending Sessions
description: Restrict this campaign to these sessions. Leave empty to use every session linked to the account.
